# Model parameters

Live default value of every coefficient in `SimTuning` (Assets/Scripts/Sim/Tuning), with the meaning
from each field's XML summary. All values are provisional until a balance pass. To change one, edit the
field initializer and regenerate: `dotnet run --project Tools/Headless/Runner -- docs`.

## Media (`MediaTuning`)

Coefficients for how airtime stirs mood now and shapes culture over decades.

| Parameter | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| MoodGain | 0.25 | Mood shift (on the 0-1 vice scale) when one vice gets all the airtime. |
| MoodTauMonths | 4 | Time constant in months for mood to follow the airtime mix. Short: media works fast. |
| MoodNoise | 0.01 | Standard deviation of the monthly news-cycle noise added to each mood value. 0 disables it. |
| CultivationYouth | 0.004 | Monthly disposition drift of youth per unit of airtime push (youth are the most susceptible). |
| CultivationAdult | 0.0015 | Monthly disposition drift of adults per unit of airtime push. |
| CultivationElder | 0.0005 | Monthly disposition drift of elders per unit of airtime push. |

## Education (`EducationTuning`)

Coefficients for how schooling trains the channels (outlets) of the next generation.

| Parameter | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| SchoolTauMonths | 72 | Time constant in months for the youth cohort's trained channels to follow the curriculum. |
| FocusChanneling | table below | Channels each curriculum focus trains, per vice. Rows follow CurriculumFocus order: Agriculture, Military, Medicine, Infrastructure, Science, Commerce, Arts. Provisional proposal awaiting Norm's review (Docs/design/INSTITUTIONS.md). |

**FocusChanneling**

| Row | Wrath | Sloth | Greed | Lust | Pride | Envy | Gluttony |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Agriculture | 0 | 0.4 | 0.2 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 |
| Military | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0.5 | 0 | 0 |
| Medicine | 0 | 0.5 | 0 | 0.6 | 0 | 0 | 0 |
| Infrastructure | 0 | 0 | 0.5 | 0 | 0.3 | 0.6 | 0 |
| Science | 0 | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0.3 | 0 |
| Commerce | 0 | 0 | 1 | 0 | 0 | 0.5 | 0.3 |
| Arts | 0 | 0.2 | 0 | 1 | 0.5 | 0.2 | 0 |

## Generations (`GenerationTuning`)

Coefficients for aging: how culture and training pass from youth to adults to elders.

| Parameter | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| YouthYears | 18 | Years a person spends in the Youth cohort. |
| AdultYears | 42 | Years a person spends in the Adult cohort before becoming an Elder. |
| HumanNature | Wrath 0.35, Sloth 0.35, Greed 0.35, Lust 0.35, Pride 0.35, Envy 0.35, Gluttony 0.35 | The disposition every culture drifts back toward without pressure ("human nature"), 0 to 1 per vice. |
| NatureTauMonths | 600 | Time constant in months of the drift back toward human nature. Long: cultures are sticky. |

## Outlets (`OutletTuning`)

Coefficients for how much of each vice a society can channel productively.

| Parameter | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| BaseOutlet | Wrath 0.25, Sloth 0.25, Greed 0.25, Lust 0.25, Pride 0.25, Envy 0.25, Gluttony 0.25 | Outlet capacity every society has before any training (family life, ordinary work, feasts), per vice. |
| ChannelGain | 0.6 | Outlet capacity added per unit of the adult cohort's trained channels. |

## Wellbeing (`WellbeingTuning`)

Coefficients for contentment, fear, crime, unrest, aggression and their alarm thresholds.

| Parameter | Value | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| ContentmentBase | 0.15 | Contentment of a society with no satisfaction, frustration, fear or crime. |
| SatisfactionGain | 0.5 | Contentment per unit of mean satisfied vice (expressed and channeled). |
| FrustrationGain | 1.2 | Suffering per unit of mean frustration (expressed vice with no outlet). |
| SlothAcceptance | 0.5 | How much expressed Sloth softens frustration into acceptance (0 = none, 1 = Sloth 1.0 cancels it). |
| FearPerSeverity | 0.6 | Fear created per unit of court severity. |
| FearSuffering | 0.3 | Suffering per unit of fear. |
| CrimeSuffering | 0.4 | Suffering per unit of crime. |
| ContentmentTauMonths | 6 | Time constant in months for contentment to follow its target. |
| CrimeBase | 0.12 | Crime present in any society regardless of frustration. |
| CrimeFromFrustration | Wrath 0.35, Sloth 0.05, Greed 0.35, Lust 0.1, Pride 0.1, Envy 0.3, Gluttony 0.1 | Crime per unit of frustration, per vice. |
| Deterrence | 0.12 | Crime prevented per unit of court severity (deterrence). |
| ContentmentCrimeRelief | 0.15 | Crime prevented per unit of positive contentment. Larger than CrimeBase on purpose, so a sufficiently content people can reach zero crime ("so happy that crime no longer takes place"). |
| CrimeTauMonths | 6 | Time constant in months for crime to follow its target. |
| UnrestFromSuffering | 0.8 | Unrest per unit of suffering (negative contentment). |
| PrideAmplifier | 0.5 | Extra unrest from suffering per unit of expressed Pride (proud people defy). |
| EnvyAmplifier | 0.5 | Extra unrest from suffering per unit of expressed Envy (relative deprivation). |
| UnrestFromWrath | 0.3 | Unrest per unit of Wrath frustration. |
| SlothDampening | 0.15 | Unrest removed per unit of expressed Sloth (complacency, acceptance). |
| FearDampening | 0.2 | Unrest removed per unit of fear (suppression, short-term). |
| UnrestTauMonths | 12 | Time constant in months for unrest to follow its target. |
| AggressionWeights | Wrath 0.45, Sloth -0.15, Greed 0.2, Lust 0, Pride 0.15, Envy 0.1, Gluttony 0.05 | Aggression per unit of expressed vice. Negative weights calm (Sloth). |
| EnvyWrathAggression | 0.4 | Aggression per unit of Envy times Wrath ("taking what others have if aggression is high"). |
| UnrestAlarm | 0.7 | Unrest above which an UnrestRising event fires. |
| UnrestCalm | 0.6 | Unrest below which an alarmed nation is considered calm again. |
| SufferingAlarm | -0.5 | Contentment below which a SufferingSevere event fires. |
| SufferingCalm | -0.4 | Contentment above which severe suffering is considered eased. |
| CrimeAlarm | 0.5 | Crime above which a CrimeWave event fires. |
| CrimeCalm | 0.4 | Crime below which a crime wave is considered over. |
